name: Eurecat
description: French catalyst services company founded in 1978, a leader in the circular economy of catalysts: off-site regeneration and rejuvenation of hydrotreating catalysts (NiMo, CoMo, NiW), spent-catalyst recycling and ex-situ activation of fresh catalysts; acquired by Axens in 2026.

sources.note: Eurecat site and search results: regeneration, rejuvenation, recycling; Axens acquisition closed February 2026, read 2026-11-11
